title: CMS Phase-2 tracker, public layout (for the C001 quirk hit-level layer)
primary_layout: tkLayout OT806_IT742 = geometry exported to CMSSW (scenario D111, CMSSW_14_1_X). It supersedes the 2017 TDR baseline: IT barrel radii changed (TDR 29.0/70.1/117.8/157.4 -> 30.0/61.5/104.5/146.5 mm), TB2S L3 1108 -> 1083 mm (76 vs 78 ladders), TEPX z positions, TBPX L1 3D sensors. Both are given.

sources.TDR: CMS Collaboration, The Phase-2 Upgrade of the CMS Tracker, CERN-LHCC-2017-009, CMS-TDR-014 (2017), INSPIRE 1614103, PDF https://inspirehep.net/files/338a99fa62dec25fcbc18d806bd7fb71 (page numbers = printed)
sources.TKL_layout: tkLayout OT806_IT742 (CMSSW D111), https://cms-tklayout.web.cern.ch/cmssw/OT806_IT742/layout.html (OT 'Layers and disks', tilted-ring tables, endcap ring radii, module-type table)
sources.TKL_pixel: tkLayout OT806_IT742 (CMSSW D111), https://cms-tklayout.web.cern.ch/cmssw/OT806_IT742/layoutpixel.html (IT 'Layers and disks', ring radii, module-type table)
sources.TKL_csv: tkLayout OT806_IT742 (CMSSW D111), https://cms-tklayout.web.cern.ch/cmssw/OT806_IT742/DetId_modules_list.csv (per-module positions; aggregated by this script)
sources.MOD_X0: arXiv:2407.13721 (CMS Tracker Group), TBPX prototype module x/X0 = 0.825% average (Table 1 / Sec.2), measured regions 0.72% and 0.95% (abstract)
sources.T3: theory_track/code/T3_propagator.py phase2_tracker() (slabs used for every truth-level number so far)
sources.MTD_TDR: CMS, A MIP Timing Detector for the CMS Phase-2 Upgrade, CERN-LHCC-2019-003, CMS-TDR-020, INSPIRE 1819664 (data/tdr_geometry/beamspot_sources/CMS-TDR-020_MTD_TDR.pdf; printed pages)
sources.HLLHC_TDR: HL-LHC Technical Design Report, CERN-2020-010, INSPIRE 1840718 (data/tdr_geometry/beamspot_sources/CERN-2020-010_HL-LHC_TDR.pdf), Table 2-1 p.18

status.VERIFIED_against_source: positions, counts, pitches and strip lengths are read from the cited public pages (no CMS-internal input)
UNVERIFIED: material x/X0 per layer (no public table)
sensor thickness: tkLayout lists 0.29 mm for OT, TDR quotes 200 um active (320 um physical option) -- only matters for dE/dx
final pixel choice: TDR studies assume 25x100 um^2 everywhere; OT806_IT742 also uses 25x100 (L1 3D)

IT_1x2.description: Inner Tracker 1x2 pixel module (2 ROCs), planar 25x100 um^2 pixels (TBPX L1: 3D sensors in OT806_IT742, 'pixel_1x2_25x100_wide_2sens_3D')
IT_1x2.long_axis: z in barrel, r in discs
sources: TKL_pixel module table (pitch 25.0, 'strip length' 99.9-100.1 um, resolutions, weight)
TDR p.74 (25x100 um^2 considered in the whole IT; 50x50 option), TDR Table 12.2 p.274 (masses), TDR p.274 (150 um IT sensors in the material model)

IT_2x2.description: Inner Tracker 2x2 pixel module (4 ROCs), 25x100 um^2

PS.description: Outer Tracker PS module: strip sensor (PS-s) 2x960 strips 100 um x ~2.35 cm above a macro-pixel sensor (PS-p) 32x960 macro-pixels 100 um x 1.467 mm; binary readout; sensor spacing 1.6/2.6/4.0 mm
PS.measures: 2D (r-phi from strips and macro-pixels; z (barrel) / r (disc) from macro-pixel 1.467 mm)
sources: TDR Table 3.3 p.37 and Table 9.4 p.157 (pitch 100 um, strip 23 472 um, macro-pixel 1 467 um, active 96.000 x 46.944 mm)
TKL_layout module table (pitch, strip length, resolution, weight)

2S.description: Outer Tracker 2S module: two strip sensors, 2x1016 strips 90 um x ~5 cm each, strips PARALLEL (no stereo); binary readout; sensor spacing 1.8/4.0 mm
2S.measures: 1D (r-phi only); z (barrel) / r (disc) known only to the 5 cm strip-row length
sources: TDR Table 3.3 p.37 (2S pitch 90 um, strip 50 274 um, active 91.440 x 100.548 mm)

material.note: No public per-layer x/X0 table. Values below: (a) one measured module, (b) module-only ESTIMATES from public masses, (c) the T3 slab values used so far (UNVERIFIED). Supports/services/cooling not included in (b). TDR Fig. 6.2 (p.98) gives the total inside the tracking volume vs |eta| only graphically (Phase-2 roughly 0.2-0.3 X0 at |eta|=0 as read by eye -- UNVERIFIED reading).
material.calibration_check: The mass-based method gives 1.3-1.5 % for TBPX modules vs 0.825 % measured (MOD_X0): it over-estimates by x1.6-1.9 (X0_eff too low and/or footprint too small). Treat module_estimates as upper bounds; scaled by 1/1.75 they give PS ~1.9-3.3 %, 2S ~1.2-1.3 % (module only).

material.baseline: T3_slabs_used (user decision 2026-10-11), systematic variation x0.5 and x2 (all layers together)
material.recommendation: Keep T3 slab values as baseline (consistent with module-only estimates plus a support share) and vary x0.5-x2 as a systematic; replace by a CMS-internal material map when available (needs CMS access).

simplified.note: Flat cylinders (barrel) and discs (endcaps) at the tkLayout nominal positions; TBPS tilted rings approximated by the flat-layer radius out to z_max (UNVERIFIED approximation: tilted sensors sit 4-15 mm farther out and are inclined 40-72 deg). Use for the hybrid ACTS geometry (Blueprint) and the fallback.

beamspot.sigma_z_source: MTD_TDR p.2 (Sec.1.1): 'line spread along the beam axis of about 4.5 cm rms (averaged over the length of the fill)'
beamspot.sigma_t_source: MTD_TDR p.2 and p.3: collisions 'distributed over time with an rms of 180-200 ps' (mid value taken)
beamspot.sigma_xy_source: ESTIMATE from HLLHC_TDR Table 2-1 p.18 (beta* = 0.15 m, eps_n = 2.50 um, E = 7 TeV): sigma*_beam = sqrt(eps_n beta*/gamma) = 7.1 um per beam, luminous = /sqrt(2); at minimum beta* (larger while levelling). Negligible against tracker resolution.
beamspot.pileup_source: BRIEF (PU 200 target); HLLHC_TDR Table 2-1 gives 131-140 for the nominal levelled scenario, 200 is the CMS ultimate-scenario design value (UNVERIFIED citation in this file)
